query:
UPDATE agents
            SET name = $2,
                instructions_revision = instructions_revision
                    + CASE WHEN instructions <> $3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                instructions = $3,
                idle_policy = $4,
                idle_delay_seconds = $6,
                dreaming_model = $7,
                task_lanes = COALESCE($8, task_lanes),
                revision = revision + 1
            WHERE id = $1
              AND revision = $5
              AND desired_state <> 'retired'
            RETURNING revision
